scripts.test: echo "No tests specified for token-service yet"
scripts.generate: yarn generate:all && yarn generate:strict && yarn generate:banned && yarn generate:polar-verified
scripts.discover-all-verified: node -e "const api = new (require('./dist/discovery/blockberry-api.js').BlockBerryAPI)(); api.getAllVerifiedTokensForPolar().then(tokens => { const fs = require('fs'); fs.writeFileSync('./data/all-verified-tokens.json', JSON.stringify(tokens, null, 2)); console.log('🎉 Got ALL', tokens.length, 'verified tokens saved to data/all-verified-tokens.json'); }).catch(console.error)"
